description: Cover letter in the user's style, honest about the robotics gap

job.title: Senior Product Manager, AI Platform
job.description: Own the roadmap of our AI platform used by robot fleets. You have 5+ years of product management, experience with B2B platforms, and ideally robotics. German is a plus.

facts.text: Senior Product Manager at Fictional Data AG, Zurich (2021-03 – present)
At Fictional Data AG (Senior Product Manager): Led a team of 6 engineers to launch a data pipeline product used by 40 enterprise customers.
At Fictional Data AG (Senior Product Manager): Grew annual recurring revenue from CHF 1.2M to CHF 3.5M in two years.
Product Manager at Sample Analytics GmbH, Berlin (2017-01 – 2021-02)
At Sample Analytics GmbH (Product Manager): Reduced customer onboarding time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks.
MSc in Computer Science, Example Technical University (2014 – 2016)

paragraphs.text: Your AI Platform role asks for someone who turns a platform into a product other teams rely on every day. That is the work I enjoy most.

At Fictional Data AG I led a team of 6 engineers to launch a data pipeline product that is now used by 40 enterprise customers, and grew its annual recurring revenue from CHF 1.2M to CHF 3.5M in two years.
I haven't worked in robotics yet. What I bring is a record of shipping B2B platforms in small, measurable steps, and native German for working with your Zurich teams.
I would be glad to discuss how I could help your platform grow.
